diagnosis: All four rollouts successfully revealed all four decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4) and cited them in justification_fact_ids, and all settled within 6 turns with no turn-cap failures. The gate failed solely because check C5 (gated by PF1, owner A2) passed in only 1 of 4 rollouts. In every rollout, PF1 was both revealed via a reveal action and cited in justification_fact_ids, so the failure is not disclosure or telepathy. The distinguishing factor is that rollout 3 (the sole pass) encoded the KafkaCloud integration as a commitment of type "integration_plan" targeting "backend" with detail "Schedule the approximately two days of KafkaCloud adapter cleanup as the integration path," whereas rollouts 0, 1, and 2 encoded the same integration work as "follow_up," "task," or "documentation" commitments. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: C5's threshold or wording requires a specific commitment form (likely an explicit integration-plan commitment type or phrasing) that the model only produces stochastically.

C5.why: The public draft favors StreamGrid, but PF1 changes the platform choice to KafkaCloud because the existing client path takes two days to adapt instead of two weeks and requires an explicit KafkaCloud integration commitment.

The draft architecture recommends StreamGrid based on simpler operational setup and an initial capacity estimate of four brokers, and both finalists met our benchmark of 20,000 messages per second with sub-250-millisecond median delivery latency. Before I record a decision, I want to hear from each of you — backend, support engineering, security, and FinOps — on any concerns or sign-off issues with either KafkaCloud or StreamGrid. Let's start with backend.

Revise C5 to accept any commitment whose detail references scheduling or proceeding with the KafkaCloud adapter cleanup / integration path (approximately two days), regardless of whether the commitment type is "integration_plan," "follow_up," "task," or "documentation." Alternatively, if C5 checks a specific commitment type field, broaden the accepted types to include "follow_up," "task," and "documentation" when the detail text contains the integration-path content from PF1.
